d: X-Series Amplifier, 75 W The AMP-X75 provides an amplifier solution that saves energy, space, and money. The modular design is easy to configure and ships with everything required to enable surface mounting, rack mounting, and ganging multiple units together.

specs.label: Frequency Response
specs.value: 20 Hz to 20 kHz ±0.5 dB at 1 W

specs.label: THD+N
specs.value: <0.1% at 1 kHz @ -3 dB full rated output power

specs.label: Input Sensitivity
specs.value: 1.23 Vrms, +4 dBu balanced; 0.316 Vrms, -10 dBV unbalanced; For 35 W (8 Ohms), 75 W (70V/100V)

specs.label: Protection
specs.value: Clipping, over current, under voltage, over temperature, DC offset, extreme high frequency

specs.label: Standby Mode
specs.value: 25 minutes with no signal present, typical
